title: Agent Harness setting.json
description: Session-specific settings. Tool selection is intentionally defined later and is not part of this first schema.

session_name.description: Human-readable session name. Defaults to the session directory name.

cwd.description: Working directory. The loader resolves it to an absolute existing directory.

system_prompt.description: Mapped to the Responses API instructions field. Defaults to an empty string.

http_debug.description: Optional native HTTP diagnostics written to http-debug.jsonl in the session directory. Disabled by default.
